summary: NIP Group Inc. (NASDAQ: NIPG), a Swedish-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a definitive on-rack sales and purchase agreement, dated September 24, 2026, to acquire operational Bitcoin mining machines totaling roughly 4.47 EH/s from unnamed sellers. Consideration is up to 247,091,740 Class A ordinary shares, with no cash price, premium, or fixed valuation disclosed. Closing is subject to customary conditions and expected within ten business days of satisfaction; the parties also executed a second amended and restated investor rights agreement covering registration rights, lock-ups, and governance. The deal lifts total installed capacity to about 13.85 EH/s. Watch share-count dilution and closing timing.
